root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `sman->response_index++`, `fuzz_send_next_response()` must establish `sman->response_index < TLV_MAX_NUM_RESPONSES` before probing `sman->responses[sman->response_index].data`.
root_cause_criterion.description: When the crashing primary-socket path increments from slot 10 to 11, the vulnerable guard still permits equality and falls through to the array probe. The fixed program stops at `>= TLV_MAX_NUM_RESPONSES` instead.

nodes.state: At the shutdown probe, `sman->response_index == TLV_MAX_NUM_RESPONSES`, so `sman->responses[sman->response_index].data` addresses `responses[11]` one past the declared `FUZZ_RESPONSE[11]` array.

edges.relation: The same post-increment `sman->response_index` value checked by the missing bound guard is reused unchanged by the immediately following shutdown probe.
